title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
description: Ten named destinations along Aggieville’s Moro Street, North Manhattan Avenue, and Laramie Street corridors, each with one directly sourced reason to stop.

cards.title: Browse a Student-Built Bookstore
cards.subtitle: North Manhattan Avenue corridor — new and used books
cards.notes: Step inside at Manhattan and Moro to browse new and used books in a building whose bookstore history began with K-State students.
cards.short_summary: A historic Aggieville bookstore with shelves, coffee, and a documented student connection.
cards.evidence_claim: The Manhattan shop is at 700 N Manhattan Ave, sells new and used books, and traces its origin to students purchasing and reopening the former college bookstore.
cards.access_notes: The official page lists Monday–Thursday 8 a.m.–8 p.m., Friday–Saturday 8 a.m.–9 p.m., and Sunday 8 a.m.–6 p.m.

cards.title: See the Old Palace Drug Store
cards.subtitle: North Manhattan Avenue corridor — doughnuts and preserved details
cards.notes: Look for the hand-laid mosaic floor and wooden booths while choosing from the shop’s daily doughnut lineup on Manhattan Avenue.
cards.short_summary: A doughnut shop occupying the historic Palace Drug Store building.
cards.evidence_claim: Varsity Donuts operates at 704 N Manhattan Avenue in the former Palace Drug Store and documents its mosaic tile floor, wooden booths, and daily doughnut production.
cards.access_notes: The official contact page lists the storefront as open daily from 6 a.m. to 8 p.m.

cards.title: Dig Through Local-Music Shelves
cards.subtitle: Moro Street corridor — independent record shop
cards.notes: Browse new and used vinyl, CDs, local music, turntables, and music accessories at this compact Moro Street record shop.
cards.short_summary: An independent music shop with physical media, equipment, and locally made recordings.
cards.evidence_claim: Sisters of Sound Records carries new and used vinyl, CDs, DVDs, turntables, guitar strings, posters, and local music.
cards.access_notes: Check the shop’s official site or contact the business before visiting; current storefront hours are not stated on the cited page.

cards.title: Pause for a Bistro Lunch
cards.subtitle: Moro Street corridor — café kitchen
cards.notes: Stop at the Moro Street counter for a meal built around the café’s documented selection of salads, soups, paninis, and flatbreads.
cards.short_summary: A corridor café offering a broad savory kitchen menu alongside its bakery service.
cards.evidence_claim: Bluestem Bistro’s kitchen serves salads, soups, paninis, flatbread pizza, and other food at 1219 Moro Street.
cards.access_notes: Consult the official site for current service hours before walking over; the cited kitchen page does not publish them.

cards.title: Choose an Aggieville Gift
cards.subtitle: Moro Street corridor — cards, flowers, and local apparel
cards.notes: Browse cards, flowers, puzzles, books, and Manhattan or K-State apparel when you need a tangible gift near campus.
cards.short_summary: A colorful Moro Street shop combining gifts, flowers, paper goods, and local apparel.
cards.evidence_claim: ACME Gift operates at 1227 Moro Street and offers gifts, cards, flowers, books, puzzles, home goods, and Manhattan and K-State apparel.
cards.access_notes: Official hours are Monday–Thursday 10 a.m.–7 p.m., Friday–Saturday 10 a.m.–8 p.m., and Sunday 11 a.m.–5 p.m.

cards.title: Print a One-Off Shirt
cards.subtitle: Moro Street corridor — custom apparel studio
cards.notes: Bring print-ready artwork to the Moro Street shop for a single custom shirt or discuss a larger apparel run with its staff.
cards.short_summary: An Aggieville print shop that accepts both individual and bulk custom-apparel projects.
cards.evidence_claim: THREAD has produced custom T-shirts in Aggieville since 2005 and offers DTF, DTG, embroidery, screen printing, and other processes with no minimum order.
cards.access_notes: The Aggieville Business Association lists the shop at 1224 Moro Street; confirm current production timing directly before visiting.

cards.title: Build a Fruit-Focused Break
cards.subtitle: Moro Street corridor — smoothies, bowls, and salads
cards.notes: Choose a smoothie, açaí bowl, or freshly prepared salad when you want a produce-centered meal along the Moro Street corridor.
cards.short_summary: A daytime café centered on fruit, vegetables, bowls, salads, and house-made items.
cards.evidence_claim: Happy Hippie’s Manhattan location at 1205–1207 Moro Street offers smoothies, açaí bowls, a freshly chopped salad bar, and house-made goods.
cards.access_notes: The official page lists the Manhattan location as open every day from 8 a.m. to 5 p.m.

cards.title: Mix an Ice-Cream Creation
cards.subtitle: Moro Street corridor — dessert beside Manhattan Avenue
cards.notes: Pick an ice-cream base and mix-ins at the Aggieville shop positioned near the Moro and Manhattan Avenue corner.
cards.short_summary: A clearly mapped dessert stop serving mixed-to-order ice cream, shakes, cakes, and smoothies.
cards.evidence_claim: Cold Stone Store #20533 is at 1225 Moro Street, adjacent to K-State in Aggieville, and serves ice cream creations, cakes, shakes, and smoothies.
cards.access_notes: The official locator lists dine-in and pickup daily from 11 a.m. to 10 p.m.

cards.title: Customize a Quick Meal
cards.subtitle: North Manhattan Avenue corridor — burritos, bowls, and salads
cards.notes: Use the customizable line for a burrito, bowl, tacos, quesadilla, or salad at the Manhattan Avenue and Laramie corner.
cards.short_summary: A fast-casual option with configurable entrées near the south edge of campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The Chipotle at 606 N Manhattan Avenue, near Manhattan Avenue and Laramie in Aggieville, serves customizable burritos, bowls, tacos, quesadillas, and salads.
cards.source_title: Chipotle Mexican Grill in Manhattan, KS
cards.access_notes: The official location page lists restaurant hours from 10:45 a.m. to 11 p.m. every day.

cards.title: Order Sushi or Hibachi
cards.subtitle: Laramie Street corridor — Japanese carryout and dining
cards.notes: Walk to 12th and Laramie for sushi, hibachi, teriyaki, soup, or appetizers, with online carryout available from the restaurant.
cards.short_summary: A Laramie Street Japanese restaurant with sushi and cooked entrée choices.
cards.evidence_claim: Green Tea Sushi at 1120 Laramie Street serves sushi, hibachi entrées, teriyaki, appetizers, soups, salads, and other Japanese dishes.
cards.access_notes: Official hours include lunch and dinner Monday–Friday and continuous noon-to-evening service Saturday and Sunday; verify holiday changes.
